title: Mexico captures FBI-wanted cartel boss in military raid
html:
Mexico captures FBI-wanted cartel boss in military raid

Mexico’s military captured FBI-wanted cartel leader ‘El Chapo Isidro’ in Guasave, Sinaloa. Armed clashes erupted as helicopters opened fire, vehicles burned and roads were blocked. Gunfire also halted a baseball game, sending players and fans scrambling for cover.
summary: Mexico’s military captured FBI-wanted cartel leader ‘El Chapo Isidro’ in Guasave, Sinaloa.
